records.name: Fishing Trawler current contribution boundary

requirements.activity_state: A live Trawler voyage, repair opportunities, contribution, success, and inspection result are player-observed.

contribution_meter.boundary: The threshold applies at the end of a successful voyage. Meter value, repair success, survival, contribution actions, and threshold crossing are never inferred.

mechanics.inspection_boundary: An eligible successful inspection can yield variable fish, junk, Angler's outfit, and pet outcomes. The model records only reported results; a voyage or contribution value does not generate items, experience, diary credit, or collection-log progress.

historical_stale_notes: The replaced activity bar model decayed and was associated with inactivity guidance. Current Fishing Trawler uses a non-depleting contribution meter.
The current 50-contribution reward threshold does not make a planned or started voyage successful.

records.name: Wintertodt current Warmth and Reward Cart boundary

requirements.activity_state: Warmth, attacks, supplies, personal points, subdual outcome, stored Reward Cart rolls, and searched results are player-observed.

mechanics.survival_resource: Since the 2024 rework, Wintertodt damage affects Warmth rather than Hitpoints. Reaching 0% Warmth causes death; the model does not infer damage, survival, death, food use, or readiness.
mechanics.reward_storage: Current qualifying rewards are stored as Reward Cart rolls. A player-initiated cart search consumes an observed stored roll and records its exact observed result; it does not generate materials, uniques, experience, or a collection-log entry automatically.
mechanics.persistent_boundary: The Reward Cart is external persistent storage, not a carried Supply Crate or an inventory item. Its balance and any search are distinct observations.

historical_stale_notes: Pre-9-October-2024 low-Hitpoints damage logic is superseded by the current Warmth model.
The former one-Supply-Crate-per-qualifying-game model is superseded by stored Reward Cart rolls.

mechanics.combat: The moons are mid-level content; good defensive bonuses reduce damage from their multi-hit basic attacks.
mechanics.prayer: Protection prayers do not negate their attacks.
mechanics.styles: Eclipse is weak to stab, Blue to crush, and Blood to slash.
mechanics.internal_supplies: Food and potions can be gathered within Neypotzli.
